description:
## Why this issue exists

The reader and transit admin servers (crates/reader/src/admin.rs, crates/transit/src/admin.rs) are hand-rolled TCP HTTP servers. They do not set standard security response headers. Add the six required headers to all response paths in write_response() or equivalent helpers. These are operator-only loopback servers but consistent header policy matters for SOC2 CC6.6 compliance.

## Acceptance criteria

- All six headers present on every admin response (reader and transit)
- Integration test asserts header presence and values
title: reader/transit admin: add security response headers to hand-rolled HTTP
